slices.summary: verify.ps1 now emits the canonical acceptance receipt when, and only when, a FINAL run reports COMPLETED / ACCEPTED / COMPLETE. The receipt binds the four distinct identities the architecture already distinguishes.
slices.note: No new gating was written. New-VerificationAcceptanceReceipt already refused every non-accepting report, invalid result hash, untrusted or not-run check, coverage-set mismatch and profile mismatch; Write-VerificationAcceptanceReceipt already refused overwrite. R1 supplies the two identity arguments that had no producer and calls the existing emitter.

slices.summary: build-windows-package.ps1 no longer prints an unconditional public-redistribution line. The summary is now derived from the selected profile's own redistributable flag.
